task_scope: Source-method audit for the nine evolved Producer_F fumarate isolates; this is not an external validation cohort.

recovered_conditions.characterization_medium: defined minimal medium MD20 with 20 g/L glucose
recovered_conditions.preculture: single colony from selective YPD plate; approximately 16 h to mid-exponential phase; centrifuged and washed twice with distilled water before inoculation
recovered_conditions.endpoint_definition: product titer at end of the growth curve
recovered_conditions.shake_flask_sample_handling: sample at stated time, centrifuge 4000 g for 10 min, filter supernatant through 0.2 um PVDF and store at -20 C
reported_fumarate_quantification_options: GC-MS with analytical standards and calibration curves
UPLC/UHPLC with PDA detection at 260 nm, Rezex ROA-Organic Acid H+ column at 65 C, 0.5 mM H2SO4 mobile phase at 0.5 ml/min, and calibration curves
recovered_conditions.replication_context: General cultivation methods state that cultivations were performed in triplicates, but Figure S3 and its source workbook do not map that statement to each fumarate endpoint or provide replicate-level endpoint values.

unresolved_for_strict_process_reproducti: The Figure S3 source table does not identify whether each released fumarate value came from the GC-MS or UPLC/UHPLC workflow.

The paper gives a general triplicate-cultivation statement, but Figure S3 and its source workbook do not show whether each released fumarate scalar is a mean, its replicate type, or replicate-level values.
Shake-flask vessel size, working volume, closure and fill ratio for the Figure S3 isolate characterization are not stated in the source table/caption.
The direct sample-collection timestamp and result-availability timestamp are not present; 57 h is reconstructed from the end-of-growth criterion and source-data crosswalk.
The source does not establish that the preserved stocks for these exact nine isolates remain available or genetically re-confirmed.

interpretation.recommended_next_step: Confirm availability and genotype of the Producer_F parent, choose a calibrated fumarate assay, record the exact culture geometry and biological replicate structure, then collect a new independent ALE cohort at a fixed 57 h endpoint. Treat this as a prospective validation under a declared assay unless the missing source assay details are recovered.
